# List of awards and nominations received by Cher

}}
Cher is an American singer and actress who has been recognized with numerous accolades for her work on music, film and television. She has won one Academy Award (out of two nominations), one Grammy Award (out of seven nominations), one Primetime Emmy Award (out of seven nominations), three Golden Globe Awards (out of six nominations) and a Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival. She has also received nominations for two British Academy Film Awards, three American Music Awards and two MTV Video Music Awards. She received numerous honorary accolades including a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame (as a part of Sonny & Cher) in 1998, GLAAD Vanguard Award in 1998, World Music Award for Outstanding Contribution to the Music Industry in 1999, Billboard Icon Award in 2017, iHeartRadio Icon Award in 2024 and Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award in 2026. In 2018, she was presented with Kennedy Center Honor. In 2024, she was inducted to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
